title: atlas(#5670 §8): atlas-backup → fleet search backup verb (verify nix copy vs surviving shell original first)

labels.name: task/small-fix
labels.description: Queue packet kind: bounded fix with reproduction and targeted tests

body:
Slice of #5670 (§8 of the Scaler-era data architecture revision, design PR #5667).

**Row:** `atlas-backup` (laptop systemd unit; nix-declared 2026-10-30) → a `fleet search` backup verb or a fleet serve maintenance role. Nightly atlas.db snapshot → laptop backups + R2 + Drive, sha256-verified.

**Precondition (from §8):** first verify the flake/nix copy matches the surviving shell original (`~/tmp/atlas-backup.sh` on the laptop). Note the other surviving copy: `hatch-personal/workspace/turso-atlas/scripts/atlas-backup.py` (21 KB, 2026-10-28) — reconcile all three before designing the verb; if they disagree, record which is live on the laptop unit today.

**Work:** verification record on this issue; then implement the backup verb/role in the fleet binary with the same destinations and sha256 verification; switch the laptop unit over; retire the outside copies.

**Acceptance:** copy-reconciliation recorded; verb lands with a test; laptop unit runs the fleet path for one nightly cycle; outside copies marked retired; #5670 updated.
